app.name: FieldVerse
app.tagline: One Farm. Three Futures. Better Decisions.

prefs.lowBandwidthHint: Hides videos, map tiles and decorative animation.

demo.bannerBody: These results were prepared by people to show how FieldVerse works. They are not machine-learning predictions or farming advice.
demo.remoteBody: Results from the connected analysis service (model {{version}}).

landing.heroBody: Explore crop-rotation possibilities using NASA climate observations, soil information, and your farming priorities.
landing.step1Body: Pick your area, your current crop and what matters most to you. No sign-up needed.
landing.step2Body: See your current rotation next to two alternatives, season by season.
landing.step3Body: Every result shows where its information comes from, and what still needs checking locally.

wizard.title: Tell us about your farm
wizard.soilPh: Soil pH (if you know it from a soil test)
wizard.history: What did you grow in the last two seasons?

constraints.title: Farmer's Right to Disagree
constraints.intro: You know your land best. Tell us what does not match your situation.
constraints.cannot_sell: I cannot sell this crop locally
constraints.excluded_crop: I do not wish to grow this crop

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We could not reach the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.SCENARIO_NOT_SUPPORTED: This combination is not prepared in the demo yet.
errors.CROP_NOT_SUPPORTED: We don't have prepared examples for this crop here yet.
errors.REGION_NOT_SUPPORTED: This place is outside the prepared demo areas.
errors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: Saving is temporarily unavailable. Everything else still works.
errors.ANALYSIS_UNAVAILABLE: The analysis service is not available right now.
errors.ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT: The analysis service took too long to answer.
errors.ANALYSIS_BAD_RESPONSE: The analysis service sent results we could not check, so we did not show them.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests — please wait a moment.
errors.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't work this out for your field.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

location.label: Where is your field located?
location.helper: Mark your field on the map or use your current location. A precise location allows us to retrieve soil, rainfall and temperature data for your area.

currentCrop.label: What are you growing on this field now?

harvestMonth.label: When do you expect to harvest this crop?

previousCrop.label: What did you grow in the previous season?
previousCrop.helper: This helps us avoid recommending crops that share pests and diseases with your earlier crops.

previousCrop2.label: What did you grow in the season before that?

nextPlanting.label: When do you plan to plant your next crop?
nextPlanting.helper: If you are unsure, we will estimate a suitable planting period from your local rainfall pattern.

seasons.label: How many growing seasons do you usually cultivate each year?

water.label: How does your field receive water?
water.limited: Limited irrigation (not available in every season)

waterlogging.label: Does water remain standing in your field during the rainy season?
waterlogging.several_weeks: Yes, for several weeks or longer

inputs.label: What level of farm inputs do you normally use?
inputs.minimal: Minimal: little or no fertiliser, local seed
inputs.moderate: Moderate: some fertiliser or improved seed
inputs.high: High: regular fertiliser, improved seed and crop protection

soil.label: Which description best matches your soil?
soil.clay: Clay: heavy and sticky when wet
soil.loam: Loam: crumbly, a mixture of sand, silt and clay

ph.label: Soil pH (if you have a soil test result)
ph.helper: Enter a value only if you have a soil test. Leaving this blank will not affect your ability to receive recommendations.

exclude.label: Are there crops you cannot or do not wish to grow?
exclude.helper: Reasons may include unavailable seed, lack of a market, or personal preference. Selected crops will not be recommended.

priorities.label: Please indicate how important each goal is to you.
priorities.helper: Your answers determine the order of the options; no option is hidden.
priorities.idleLand: Make productive use of fallow periods

review.heading: Review your information
review.intro: Please check your answers before we prepare your recommendations. You may edit any section.
review.notice: Where you selected "I do not know", we estimate the value from satellite and regional data. These recommendations will carry a lower confidence level.
review.disclaimer: These recommendations are decision-support guidance based on regional data. They do not replace advice from a local agricultural extension officer.
review.unknownCount: You answered "I do not know" or skipped {{count}} question(s).
